items.text: Among adults who frequently attend the region's emergency departments, is enrolment in case management before an index date associated with lower odds of death or intensive care admission within 12 months?
items.population: Adults with eight or more ED visits in 12 months at the region's EDs
items.intervention: Case management enrolment before the index date (exposure)
items.comparator: No enrolment before the index date
items.outcome: Death or ICU admission within 12 months (case definition)
items.time: Index dates from program start to December 2025
items.setting: Tertiary ED, with the two community EDs if needed

finer: Feasible with approvals in place and two research assistants; interesting to the health authority; novel on hard outcomes; ethical with de-identified extracts; relevant to the funding review.
summary: One PECO question stated for the region, so that it holds whether one or three sites are used.
